GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t? (1 mark)

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc? (1 mark)

   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a? (1 mark)
